authority: RAMANUJAN_RESEARCH_AUTHORIZED remains false; these contracts never grant launch authority or a capability verdict.
global_laws: Each qualifying result is bound to immutable inputs and a sealed receipt.
A generator may not grade or promote its own output.
An unavailable verifier is a refusal, never a partial pass.
Frozen evaluation material is never used to fit the candidate under test.

contracts.name: offline reproducibility
contracts.purpose: Reproduce a pinned Lean capsule in a network-disabled container.
contracts.admission: All four are MET by the independent prover; no host-only substitute.

contracts.name: frozen split integrity
contracts.purpose: Show that a train/dev/test membership is deterministic, provenance-bound and isolated from held-out evaluation.
contracts.admission: All required fields match a sealed split manifest; any non-deterministic member or evaluation leak REFUSES the run.

contracts.name: independent rediscovery
contracts.purpose: Measure rediscovery of results withheld before the candidate receives its task inputs.
required_evidence: sealed hidden membership before candidate launch
contracts.admission: Only an independently sealed D8 set and an independent adjudicator may issue a result; an absent D8 set is PENDING, not zero credit.

contracts.name: frontier-variant reach
contracts.purpose: Measure progress on licensed variants of open problems without representing a proxy as resolution of the source problem.
contracts.admission: A result names the exact variant and verifier outcome; it never promotes an open problem from proxy performance.

contracts.name: formalization fidelity
contracts.purpose: Establish that a Lean formalization states the intended informal claim.
contracts.admission: The formalizer cannot assess its own output; lack of independent fidelity assessment leaves the claim below Tier 2.

contracts.name: proof verification
contracts.purpose: Establish that a formalized claim compiles under the pinned Lean/Mathlib environment.
contracts.admission: All five Tier-3 requirements are required. Compiler feedback may generate repair proposals but cannot be a proof verdict.

contracts.name: governed research execution
contracts.purpose: Ensure a qualified result passes through the seven stores, Ledger, Tribunal, limits and artifact capability fence without bypass.
contracts.admission: The current launch and capability fences remain authoritative. A Q6 pass cannot set either fence or authorize training.
